terminologyReview: Guideline corrections: all are accurate and stated as native instructions rather than copied English modals. (1) eo.md and be.md now say what common.md and ga.md say: in Workers, Intl.ListFormat and Intl.RelativeTimeFormat fall back to English for these languages, Intl.PluralRules supports them, and Bickr uses explicit catalog patterns and rejects missing entries. This matches intl-workerd.json and InstructionTemplates, which throws on a missing message or count variant. The old "runtime formatters silently return English" wording is gone. (2) fr.md, pt.md and it.md now say that count parameters render ASCII digits, that a category does not insert million/milliard, milhão/milhões or milione/milioni, that de/di follows only the written numeral construction, and that many may match other for an all-digit numeral. This matches String(value) in instruction-template.ts and the platform labels "il y a 1 000 000 minutes", "há 1.000.000 minutos" and "1.000.000 minuti fa". (3) de.md separates positive obligations (Sie müssen) from prohibitions (dürfen nicht), states that "Darf nicht leer sein" is the form for a required nonempty value, and warns that "muss nicht" means need not. That is the correct German modal system: English "must not" maps to "darf nicht", not to "muss nicht".

Belarusian guideline and lead terminology record: be.md is accurate and simple. (1) It names Intl.ListFormat and Intl.RelativeTimeFormat as the Workers fallback for be. It states that Intl.PluralRules supports Belarusian, and that Bickr uses explicit catalog patterns and rejects missing entries. This matches intl-workerd.json and the catalog loader. (2) It keeps the official 2008 orthography as the single standard. (3) It treats павінен and трэба as a consistent catalog style choice. It correctly says that мусіць is also standard Belarusian and does not by itself identify an orthography. The cited academic etymological dictionary (verbum.by/esbm) documents мусіць with obligation senses and cites the standard explanatory dictionary, so calling it a Taraškievica marker would be wrong. The final catalog uses павінен or павінны in 79 units and мусіць in none, so the style choice is applied consistently. (4) сродак кіравання names a Bickr control (10 units) and інструмент names a tool (48 units). The one other use, "сродак кіравання тэхнічным абслугоўваннем" in issue.service.maintenanceUnavailable, carries an explicit qualifier, so it cannot be mistaken for a participant-callable control.
The guideline states obligations and prohibitions with native means (трэба or вы павінны, не or нельга) rather than mapping English modals one to one, which is the right approach.

grok.terminologyReview: The revised references give simple native instructions and do not copy English modal labels onto native grammar. common.md, ga.md, eo.md, and be.md name Intl.ListFormat and Intl.RelativeTimeFormat. In the current Workers runtime those two APIs fall back to English for Esperanto, Belarusian, and Irish. Intl.PluralRules supports their categories. Bickr catalog formatters reject a missing entry and use explicit native patterns. The older phrase that runtime formatters silently return English describes that platform fallback and would misdescribe Bickr. French, Portuguese, and Italian count parameters render as ASCII digits. A many category does not insert million, milliard, milhão, milhões, milione, or milioni. de or di is used only when the written numeral construction requires it. A many variant can match other when the numeral is entirely digits. Native Intl.RelativeTimeFormat gives a round million a direct numeric plural label in those three languages. German uses müssen for a positive obligation, nicht with the imperative for a negative command, and dürfen nicht for a prohibition. Darf nicht leer sein is the native way to require a nonempty value. muss nicht means need not. The Belarusian reference keeps the official 2008 orthography. Obligations use павінен or трэба as one catalog style, and prohibitions use не or нельга. The lead terminology record makes the same obligation choice and uses сродак кіравання for a Bickr control and інструмент for a tool.
